# Differences below the threshold

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Where the exchange follows a formation's couplings, a difference in a stock coupled into it by threshold only stays until the two webs' support diverges; coupling the stock in by level lifts it, and others responding to the stock itself break it.

`subthreshold-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-16T18:25:05+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Let two flows balance at each step on every condition coupled into a formation g (by threshold or by level), and let the exchange around g follow its couplings: wherever the two flows have been alike through g's couplings up to a step, they take from and give to every condition coupled into g alike across that step, in total over every formation present (Flow.ExchangeFollows). Then while the flows are alike through g's couplings, every difference on a condition coupled into g stays as it was at the start (Flow.difference_kept). Where the second web starts at least as high on what couples into g and alike on what couples into it by level, the webs are alike through g's couplings at every step before which the first web supported it (Flow.alike_while_supported), any number of conditions differing; where a difference has changed by a step, at some earlier step the second web's levels admitted g and the first web did not support it, and where activity needs support g was not active in the first web at every earlier step (Flow.difference_changes_after_divergence). Where the starts differ only in one stock coupled into g by threshold only, d higher in the second web, at every step before which the first web supported g at every step the stock stands exactly d higher, every other condition coupled into g stands alike and the webs have been alike through g's couplings (Flow.subthreshold_alike), and at every step where the first web supports g at every step (Flow.subthreshold_alike_always). Witnesses: in SupportDrawn a formation needing one unit draws one unit at each supported step, the exchange following its support only; the difference stands through the third step, where the lower web fails to support it and the higher supports it, and has changed by the fourth (SupportDrawn.difference_waits); in JointFailure both webs fail the formation from the second step and the difference stands at every step (JointFailure.difference_kept); in Gauged a formation into which its stock couples by level draws all of it above its need at the first step and draws on the difference in the higher web, the exchange following its couplings constraining nothing, while with only support coupled in the exchange does not follow its couplings (Gauged.gauge_changes_difference); carving the stock as its own standing, a gauge of oneself is the gauge of the stock (Gauged.own_is_stock); in Attracting a taker drawn by the higher stock makes the higher web fail the dependent at the second step, the exchange not following its couplings (Attracting.higher_breaks_first); in SelfPrey, with the prey depending on its own standing at need one, a bite of one leaves the webs alike through support at every step and shows through a gauge of oneself at the second, and a bite of two shows through support at the second step (SelfPrey.threshold_on_oneself). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Balance is assumed only on the conditions coupled in, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn, singleton families, needing no finiteness); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on.
- The exchange following what couples in (Flow.ExchangeFollows) is a supplied hypothesis, not derived from the dynamics: it concerns the whole exchange around g and excludes others responding to what does not couple into g; Attracting is the counterexample where it fails.
- Coupling: into a formation couple its support (whether the levels admit it), by threshold, and the levels of the conditions coupled into it by level (obs, a parameter, with thresholdOnly the base). Activity is supplied by the representation and is not counted as coupled in; under Web.Dependent it cannot outrun support.
- For the witnesses: their flows and webs (SupportDrawn, JointFailure, Gauged, Attracting, SelfPrey).
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions (DecidableEq) is used only to split cases on conditions, and no classical reasoning is used.

Ren's proposal: “can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”, and “I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”. The AI's answer proposed three blindnesses of feedback, a runaway as a loop running inside one of them, the ways across them, falsifiability as the condition of being corrected by the unfolding, and a reading of 理; Ren answered “agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”. The independent review narrowed the readings: each blindness has its scope (below a threshold where the exchange follows what couples in, beyond the horizon where the continuation is open, beyond the coupling closure where the members respond only through their own couplings); the runaway reading is a heuristic, not a statement; and 理 is read as a model answerable to registration (later, following Ren, as the modeling of the laws of structure and change). So the readings recorded here are the AI's narrowed ones, adopted on Ren's delegation (D26), not the wording Ren accepted. Question 4, whether a formation's own standing counts as registered, was decided by the AI after exploring the options: only support couples into the base (thresholdOnly); in the one-kind reading own standing couples in by threshold through self-bearing (Web.SelfBearing); and a gauge of oneself (ownStanding) is an observation premise. The reasons are in §70.1 of the integration note. The Chinese for “registers” was 计入, as in P42; Ren found it “apparently weird” and asked for a better word, the AI proposed 反映, and Ren chose 识 (“for registers, use 识”): a difference showing in the formation's state (§70.2 of the integration note). Under the naming decision of 18 October 2026 “registers” became “couples into”, and 识 is kept for a formation's course through the lumping its couplings make.

That a formation observes anything beyond its support, gauges its own standing or wants to avoid a runaway is not derived; the exchange following what couples in is a supplied hypothesis, and which unfoldings meet it is empirical; loops, gain and runaway are treated in how-loops-form, where-novelty-gain-comes-from and runaway-distance-unregistered, not here; observation is exact, and measurement with error (calibration) is not modelled; the readings are the AI's, narrowed by the review, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

- Where others respond to the stock itself the exchange does not follow what couples in, and a higher stock can end the dependent first: in Attracting a taker drawn by a stock of three makes the higher web fail the dependent at the second step while the lower web still supports it (Attracting.higher_breaks_first). The unqualified reading that losses show only at the break fails here. [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)
- Observing the stock lifts the blindness below the threshold: in Gauged a formation into which its stock couples by level is supported at every step in both webs and draws on the difference in the higher one (Gauged.gauge_changes_difference).
